jobs.description:

We are adding to our diverse team of experts and are looking to hire those who are committed to building a culture that enables the creation of innovative solutions for our business units and clients.

The Company

Welcome to Munich Re Specialty - North America, a leading specialty insurance provider dedicated to delivering exceptional underwriting, claims, and risk management expertise to our partners and customers. As a trusted industry expert, we offer a broad range of comprehensive and customized solutions, including casualty, professional lines, property, surety, and public entity coverages. With the financial strength and global resources of our A+ Superior (A.M. Best) rated organization, we provide unmatched stability and reliability. Our team is committed to superior service levels, a distinctive approach to specialty solutions, and a deep understanding of the complex risks our clients face. Join our team and be part of a dynamic and experienced organization that is shaping the future of specialty insurance in North America.

The Opportunity

Future focused and always one step ahead!

The Financial Reporting Technical Analyst role supports data analytics and financial reporting systems for Munich Re Specialty North America (MRSNA) by helping generate insights, automate recurring reports, and maintain key reporting platforms. This position works with team members and subject matter experts to support reporting platforms such as GPS/SBA, FS-RI, EDWH, TM1, GPS+ Planning/Forecasting and related data stores including EDWH, IRDW, and Data Market Place. Responsibilities include data analysis, report development, data quality review, assistance with SAC (GPS+) administration, support for automated reporting interfaces, Power BI dashboard creation / maintenance, and participation in cross-functional projects. Required qualifications include a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, familiarity with tools such as Power BI, SQL, Python, and SAP, and strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills across IT, Finance, and Actuarial functions.

The Financial Reporting Technical Analyst combines analytical capability with technical knowledge of financial reporting systems. This position supports business analytics initiatives and Munich Re Specialty North America (MRSNA)’s financial planning, forecasting, and reporting processes. The role assists with developing automated reporting solutions, maintaining reporting outputs, and supporting key reporting platforms and data environments under the guidance of senior team members and subject matter experts.

Responsibilities

Support the flow of MRS NA financial data

Support the review and understanding of MRS NA financial data flows from policy administration systems such as FS-RI, ISyCL, and SAP to the general ledger and reporting warehouses such as TM1, EDWH, and IRDW.
Assist IT and subject matter experts with maintaining and updating financial master data used for reporting processes and applications.
Prepare financial data queries and ad hoc reporting outputs to support corporate reporting requirements, with guidance from senior team members as needed.
Participate as a Finance representative in cross-functional projects that support new reporting requirements or system implementations.

Support MRS NA’s Planning and Forecasting platform

Work with local and Munich-based staff to support SAC functionality for annual planning and quarterly forecast reporting and analysis.
Assist IT staff with automated interfaces of key data used in consolidated reporting and monitoring of results.
Support updates to calculation rules based on evolving or new reporting requirements.
Maintain and enhance AFO / SAC reports to support analysis and results monitoring.

Technical Reporting Systems & Automation Support

Assist with developing and maintaining financial-based data models and analytical data products.
Perform data analysis in collaboration with data engineers, modelers, architects, and SMEs to support improvements in data collection, storage, and quality.
Identify potential gaps and anomalies in data flows and escalate findings with recommended next steps.
Create reporting outputs, dashboards, and insights to support management decision-making.
Support automated interfaces and pipelines used for consolidated reporting.
Develop and maintain Power BI reporting infrastructure to support regular financial reports produced by MRS NA Finance, such as monthly expense reporting and business unit financial schedules, in partnership with Financial Reporting Analysts and other stakeholders.
Coordinate with the Analytics team to support alignment of KPIs and consistent formatting of financial reports and other reports used during quarterly results monitoring.

Qualifications

Successful candidates will possess the following experience/skills/qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
5+ years of data analytics, financial analysis, reporting, or related experience.
Working knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, Databricks, or data profiling tools.
Experience with SQL, Python, R, Java, or similar languages preferred.
Familiarity with TM1, EDWH, IRDW, FS-RI, SAP-BO, or similar reporting and financial systems.
General understanding of data warehousing, ETL, and reporting system concepts.
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, self‑prioritize, and meet deadlines.
Excellent communication skills—verbal, written, presentation.
Effective collaboration across IT, Finance, Data, Accounting, and Actuarial.

Why ARA at Stryker?

The Assurance & Risk Advisory (ARA) function at Stryker continues to grow as we strengthen our focus on technology-enabled risk management, governance, and assurance. We are seeking a Senior Technology Risk Analyst to play a critical role in helping the organization proactively manage technology risks while supporting Stryker’s strategic objectives. This role offers the opportunity to work with a global, collaborative team that delivers value through innovation, strong partnerships, and customer focus.

As the Senior Technology Risk Analyst, you will be responsible for executing technology-focused internal audit and risk advisory engagements, including SOX compliance testing, system implementation reviews, technology and data risk assessments, and operational audits. This individual serves as a subject matter expert in the auditing of IT general controls (ITGCs), IT automated controls (ITACs), and key reports across ERP platforms and other enterprise applications. The role requires knowledge and experience with internal control frameworks, and audit methodologies, as well as a strong understanding of financial reporting risks and technology-enabled business processes. The Senior Technology Risk Analyst applies internal audit principles and practices aligned with AICPA and PCAOB guidance / standards to assess control design and test operating effectiveness while providing clear concise reporting to key stakeholders within ARA team and broader organization.

What You Will Do

Participate in audit planning by understanding business processes, identifying technology risks, and developing risk-based audit procedures.
Perform process walkthroughs, control evaluations, and testing to assess the design and operating effectiveness of technology controls.
Test IT General Controls (ITGCs), automated controls, and key reports across enterprise applications and technology infrastructure to support SOX 404 compliance.
Support technology advisory and consulting engagements related to system implementations, process changes, and technology initiatives.
Prepare high-quality audit workpapers and documentation in alignment with internal audit methodology, professional standards, and department policies.
Analyze audit evidence, identify control gaps and process improvement opportunities, and clearly document audit observations.
Partner with Management to develop remediation action plans, monitor progress, and validate the resolution of identified control deficiencies.
Review SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports for third-party service providers and assess their impact on the organization’s overall control environment.

What You Need

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, accounting, finance, or a related field
Minimum 2 years of professional experience in public accounting, internal audit, or management consulting
Experience testing ITGCs across enterprise applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments
SAP S/4 audit experience
Experience supporting business process audit teams in the testing of automated controls, key reports, and other IT-dependent controls
Strong understanding of internal audit principles, methodologies, and professional standards
